title: Political Compass or Spinning Arrow? Towards More Meaningful Evaluations for Values and Opinions in Large Language Models
authors: Röttger, Paul; Hofmann, Valentin; Pyatkin, Valentina; Hinck, Musashi; Kirk, Hannah Rose; Schütze, Hinrich; Hovy, Dirk
notes: arXiv:2402.16786 [cs.CL]. Case study using the PCT to argue that constrained (multiple-choice) evaluations of LLM values are unreliable. Five experiments on Llama2, Mistral, Zephyr, GPT-3.5, GPT-4 with temperature=0.
